♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: For most of the day the Moon moves through Pisces in Revati in your 12th house, then slips into your own sign by evening, shifting you from inward, dreamlike reflection to sharp, immediate action. With the Sun, retrograde Mercury and Venus all in Libra in your 7th house, and Mars conjoined exalted Jupiter in Cancer in your 4th, relationship themes and home matters are strongly activated. Saturn in Pisces and Rahu in Aquarius keep you aware of limits in your energy and the quality of your friendships. Today begins quietly but can end with a decisive personal turn.

💼 Career: The Pisces Moon early on favors work done behind the scenes: cleaning up old files, finishing loose ends, reviewing strategies and replaying recent interactions to see what you missed. As the Moon enters Aries, you may feel a sudden urge to launch, speak up or take charge. With three planets in your 7th, key clients, bosses or collaborators are central to progress; retrograde Mercury suggests that clarifying old agreements or re-opening stalled negotiations could bring more benefit than chasing something brand new. Mars–Jupiter in the 4th ask you to consider how your working arrangements impact your family or living situation before saying yes to extra responsibilities.

❤️ Love: The Libra focus on your 7th house makes partnerships a mirror right now. If you’re attached, conversations about fairness, mutual effort and emotional availability are likely to surface. Retro Mercury and Venus can bring back a topic you both thought you’d buried or reconnect you with an earlier phase of your bond; the task is to update the agreement, not relive the past. If single, someone from your existing orbit could become more prominent, but don’t rush; let the Moon’s shift into Aries help you notice how you actually feel in their presence, not just how the story looks on paper.

💰 Money: Mars and Jupiter in your 4th spotlight home and family expenses—rent, repairs, relocations, or investments that make your base more secure. There can be enthusiasm for big changes, but it’s wise to check whether you’re trying to solve an emotional discomfort with a financial move. The Libra cluster in your 7th also points to shared finances, business partnerships or contracts; this is a good day to review terms, fee splits and obligations, especially those agreed to months ago when the context was different.

🧘 Advice: Use the contemplative first half of the day to sort thoughts and gather facts, so that when the Moon enters Aries and your impulse to act rises, you have a clear sense of where your energy is truly needed.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you pause long enough to choose your battles instead of reacting to every spark, your fire starts changing rooms instead of just heating them.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Pisces Moon in Revati travels through your 11th house of networks and visions for the day, and later edges toward your 12th, blending social currents with a need for quiet. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus—your ruler—all gather in Libra in your 6th house of work and health, while Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer energize your 3rd house of communication. Saturn in Pisces in your 11th asks you to take your long-term aims and associations seriously. The mood is busy, but not all activity is equally meaningful.

💼 Career: Today is excellent for reviewing how you actually function in teams and systems. The Libra emphasis in your 6th can highlight imbalances in workload, unclear expectations, or a desire to refine your role. Retro Venus and Mercury favor reworking schedules, renegotiating duties or revisiting a previous job arrangement rather than abruptly changing direction. Mars–Jupiter in your 3rd give you courage and eloquence: emails, presentations and proposals can carry more weight now, but avoid over-promising or spreading yourself thin across too many projects just to be liked.

❤️ Love: Your emotional barometer is sensitive to whether your daily life supports or undermines your relationships. If partnered, you may feel called to talk about practical cooperation—who handles which chores, how stress is managed, and whether both of you feel supported in your routines. With the Moon in your 11th, friends or community events could provide a backdrop for meaningful couple conversations. If single, attraction may emerge through shared causes, classes or group activities; you’re likely drawn to someone whose schedule and values actually fit yours rather than just being exciting.

💰 Money: The 6th-house Libra cluster points toward wages, service-related income and recurring expenses. This is a good day to look at how much time and energy you exchange for money and whether the equation still feels fair. Mars–Jupiter in the 3rd might provoke spending on transport, technology, courses or marketing; choose what clearly boosts your skills or reach instead of impulsive upgrades. A quiet review of subscriptions, small payments and memberships can reveal room to simplify without feeling deprived.

🧘 Advice: Notice which collaborations leave you calmer and more focused afterward; those are the ones worth building into your long-term plan.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop buying your place in the group with overwork or overgiving, the people who truly value you don’t go anywhere.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces, Revati, lights up your 10th house of visibility and responsibility, putting your public role under a gentle but clear spotlight. Your ruler Mercury is retrograde in Libra alongside the Sun and Venus in your 5th house of creativity and play, while Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer activate your 2nd house of income and self-worth. Saturn in Pisces brings a serious tone to career choices. Today has a quietly ambitious flavor: you’re invited to reimagine how you show up in the world.

💼 Career: With the Moon high in your chart and Saturn nearby, others may look to you for maturity, nuance or problem-solving. At the same time, the Libra trio in your 5th suggests that your edge comes from originality, aesthetics and the way you tell the story of what you do. Retrograde Mercury is perfect for revisiting a creative project, pitch, brand element or teaching idea you set aside earlier in the year. Mars–Jupiter in your 2nd encourage you to advocate for fair compensation or to recalibrate your pricing, but do it from a grounded sense of value rather than from frustration.

❤️ Love: Romance and self-expression are intertwined. If partnered, you may feel like experimenting with shared activities—art, games, social outings—but also re-examining an old pattern around attention and approval. Retro Venus and Mercury in your 5th can bring back a past crush, revive an old hobby you enjoyed together, or prompt nostalgia; use it to see how your tastes have matured. If single, someone who appreciates your wit and ideas could stand out, possibly a person you already know in a casual or social context.

💰 Money: Mars and Jupiter in your 2nd house can increase both earning potential and spending impulses. Motivation to improve your financial base is high—asking for better terms, consolidating income streams, or committing to a savings goal can all be fruitful. Just watch for the temptation to immediately spend increases in income on status symbols or generous gestures. The 10th-house Moon reminds you that consistency in financial behavior shapes your reputation as much as your job title.

🧘 Advice: Before you chase a new title or accolade, ask whether your current work showcases the facets of you that want to be seen; adjustment from the inside out will stick better than chasing external markers.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your outer success starts reflecting what you actually enjoy doing, recognition stops feeling like pressure and starts feeling like fuel.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, travels through Pisces in Revati in your 9th house of perspective, study and distant horizons, then prepares to cross into Aries later, nudging big-picture thinking into concrete decisions. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and Venus in Libra highlight your 4th house of home and emotional foundations, while Mars with exalted Jupiter in your own sign supercharge your 1st house. Saturn in Pisces deepens your search for meaning. You’re simultaneously expanding your world and rearranging your base.

💼 Career: With Mars–Jupiter in your sign, others may see you as more dynamic and capable than usual, and opportunities to lead or initiate can arise. The Pisces Moon in your 9th is favorable for planning courses, certifications, relocations or long-term projects that align with your values. Yet the Libra emphasis in your 4th reminds you that your inner stability and living situation must be part of any professional equation. This is a strong day to map how changes in your home—room usage, routine, even emotional boundaries—can support the ambitions that are waking up in you.

❤️ Love: Emotional security is central today. If partnered, conversations may revolve around living arrangements, family involvement, and the balance between personal growth and shared comfort. Retrograde Mercury and Venus in your 4th can bring old family narratives or unresolved domestic tensions back into focus; instead of reacting from habit, use your current maturity to shape a new pattern. If single, your attraction radar is tuned to those who feel both grounding and expansive—people who respect your roots and are curious about your dreams.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your sign can make you more optimistic, while Mars adds urgency. Channel this into structured action: creating a realistic plan for savings, education, or a move can pay off. The Libra planets in your 4th highlight household expenses, décor, repairs or shared costs with housemates or family. A thoughtful reallocation of resources at home—cutting what doesn’t support your real needs and investing a little in what does—can have an outsized emotional effect.

🧘 Advice: Let any restlessness about the future guide you to refine the ground you stand on now; strengthening your base will make the next leap feel less risky.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop building your life only around keeping things familiar, your sense of home starts traveling with you instead of holding you back.
leo:
♌ Leo

The Sun—your ruler—along with retrograde Mercury and Venus, travels through Libra in your 3rd house of communication, while Mars conjoined exalted Jupiter in Cancer activates your 12th house of retreat and the subconscious. Saturn in Pisces in your 8th asks for emotional honesty. Today favors inner housekeeping over outer display.

The Pisces Moon in your 8th can bring awareness to power dynamics at work—who holds information, who carries hidden pressure, who gets credit. Retro Mercury suggests going back over recent conversations, proposals or contracts to see what was implied but not stated. Mars–Jupiter in the 12th favor focused effort on long-term background projects, research or spiritual practices that indirectly support your professional life by clearing mental clutter.

❤️ Love: Intimacy, trust and private truths are highlighted. If you’re partnered, subjects you usually sidestep—finances, fears, past hurts—may come up gently but insistently. The combination of Pisces Moon and Saturn helps you voice vulnerable truths with more maturity, provided you don’t rush the process. If single, you may notice patterns in the kinds of people you’re drawn to—especially those who seem mysterious or unavailable. Today is powerful for examining those patterns and choosing a different response, even if you don’t act on it immediately.

💰 Money: The 8th-house activation brings attention to shared assets, inheritances, taxes, loans or long-term obligations. It’s a good day to quietly review joint accounts, repayment plans, or the emotional weight of certain financial ties. Mars–Jupiter in your 12th caution against using secret or escapist spending as a stress release. Instead, consider setting up or adding to a discreet emergency fund or paying down one lingering obligation—small steps that increase your sense of quiet control.

🧘 Advice: Give weight to the hunches and bodily signals that repeat today; they’re pointing to places where your outer agreements and inner truth are out of sync.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating vulnerability as a performance risk and start treating it as accurate data, your choices become both braver and wiser.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

Saturn in Pisces in your 7th makes partnership decisions feel weighty and real. The universe is asking: who are you building with, and on what terms?

With the Libra trio in your 2nd, you’re invited to think carefully about compensation, boundaries and what “fair exchange” truly looks like. Retro Mercury is ideal for reworking contracts, revisiting past offers or adjusting how you present your skills. Mars–Jupiter in your 11th encourage bolder participation in groups or communities, but choose those whose ethics and structure match your own.

If attached, conversations about money, chores and emotional labor may arise; they don’t have to be heavy if approached with curiosity instead of blame. Mars–Jupiter in the 11th may bring opportunities or expenses through friends, networks or group projects; be generous within reason, but avoid committing money where expectations are vague. ⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop proving your reliability by absorbing everyone else’s slack, the relationships that remain are the ones that truly see your worth.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces, Revati, moves through your 6th house of routines, health and service, asking you to fine-tune the small things that carry your days. Meanwhile, the Sun, retrograde Mercury and your ruler Venus are all in your own sign, activating your 1st house of identity and appearance. Mars and exalted Jupiter in Cancer highlight your 10th house of career, and Saturn in Pisces in your 6th calls for sustainable effort. You’re rewriting how you move through the world, not just how you look in it.

💼 Career: With Mars–Jupiter at the top of your chart, professional momentum is strong—responsibilities, visibility or leadership opportunities may expand. The Pisces Moon in your 6th reminds you that your output depends on how you manage your body and schedule: small adjustments in sleep, breaks, or task order can have large effects. Retro Venus and Mercury in your 1st suggest it’s a time to reconsider your public persona and how you advocate for yourself. Updating a portfolio, revising your bio or changing how you speak about your work can shift how others respond.

❤️ Love: With several planets in your sign, your desires and boundaries in relationships are up for review. If attached, you may feel a pull to renegotiate unspoken deals—how you share time, whose preferences dominate, how much you compromise your own rhythm to keep peace. The 6th-house Moon encourages practical expressions of care, like helping with tasks or adjusting routines, over dramatic gestures. If single, you may reconnect with someone from your past or re-encounter an old pattern in a new person; use what you’ve learned about yourself this year to choose differently.

There may be chances to take on additional duties or step into a higher-profile role that can later support financial growth. At the same time, be careful not to accept responsibilities without clear terms; retro Mercury favors asking detailed questions now. Watch for the urge to spend on beautifying yourself or your environment as a way to cope—select one or two upgrades that honestly make daily life smoother instead of scattering funds.

🧘 Advice: Treat the way you structure your days as an expression of self-respect; when your schedule honors you, it becomes much easier to set boundaries elsewhere.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop chasing balance as an image and start building it into your habits, harmony stops slipping through your fingers.
scorpio:

capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Pisces, Revati, moves through your 3rd house of communication, learning and local environment, making today mentally active and subtly emotional. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and Venus in Libra occupy your 10th house of status and vocation, while Mars with exalted Jupiter in Cancer energize your 7th house of partnerships. Your ruler Saturn in Pisces in the 3rd urges precision in words and decisions. This is a day of conversations and choices that can quietly redirect your path.

Retro Mercury and Venus in Libra favor reviewing old agreements, performance evaluations, branding or leadership styles rather than forcing a completely new direction. The Pisces Moon in your 3rd supports nuanced communication—this is an excellent time for thoughtful emails, negotiations, or revising important documents. Mars–Jupiter in your 7th indicate that partners, clients or competitors may act decisively; you’ll likely be called to respond quickly while maintaining your standards.

Be generous but firm, and avoid signing up for obligations based solely on someone else’s enthusiasm.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you treat your words as commitments instead of fillers, people quickly show whether they’re worthy of being part of your plans.
